sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(profile_id) = 36 AND profile_id = lower(profile_id) AND profile_id GLOB '????????-????-4???-[89ab]???-????????????' AND NOT("replace"(profile_id, '-', '') GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), "display_name" TEXT CHECK (display_name IS NULL OR length(trim(display_name)) > 0), "avatar_key" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (avatar_key IN ('island_01', 'island_02', 'island_03', 'island_04')), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stats_started_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "match_records" ("match_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(match_id) = 36 AND match_id = lower(match_id) AND match_id GLOB '????????-????-4???-[89ab]???-????????????' AND NOT("replace"(match_id, '-', '') GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(profile_id), "execution_id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(execution_id) = 36 AND execution_id = lower(execution_id) AND execution_id GLOB '????????-????-4???-[89ab]???-????????????' AND NOT("replace"(execution_id, '-', '') GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')), "session_kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (session_kind = 'normal'), "origin" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin = 'gameplay'), "game_mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (game_mode = 'player_vs_cpu'), "difficulty" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (difficulty IN ('very_easy', 'easy', 'normal', 'hard')), "player_cpu_difficulty" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (player_cpu_difficulty IN ('very_easy', 'easy', 'normal', 'hard')), "island_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (island_count BETWEEN 8 AND 16), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('in_progress', 'completed', 'abandoned', 'interrupted')), "outcome" TEXT CHECK (outcome IN ('win', 'loss', 'draw')), "started_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at_utc" INTEGER, "recovered_at_utc" INTEGER, "elapsed_ms" INTEGER CHECK (elapsed_ms >= 0), "dispatch_count" INTEGER CHECK (dispatch_count >= 0), "forces_sent" INTEGER CHECK (forces_sent >= 0), "captures" INTEGER CHECK (captures >= 0), "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(app_version)) > 0), "rules_version" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(rules_version)) > 0), "metrics_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (metrics_version >= 1), "receipt_xp" INTEGER CHECK (receipt_xp >= 0), "receipt_before" INTEGER CHECK (receipt_before >= 0), "receipt_after" INTEGER CHECK (receipt_after >= 0), "receipt_reward_version" TEXT, UNIQUE(match_id, profile_id), CHECK((status = 'in_progress' AND outcome IS NULL AND ended_at_utc IS NULL AND recovered_at_utc IS NULL AND elapsed_ms IS NULL AND dispatch_count IS NULL AND forces_sent IS NULL AND captures IS NULL AND receipt_xp receipt_xp = 0)AND((status = 'completed' AND outcome IS NOT NULL AND ended_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND recovered_at_utc IS NULL AND elapsed_ms IS NOT NULL AND dispatch_count IS NOT NULL AND forces_sent IS NOT NULL AND captures IS NOT NULL)OR(status = 'abandoned' AND outcome IS NULL AND ended_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND recovered_at_utc IS NULL AND elapsed_ms IS NOT NULL AND dispatch_count IS NOT NULL AND forces_sent IS NOT NULL AND captures IS NOT NULL)OR(status = 'interrupted' AND outcome IS NULL AND ended_at_utc IS NULL AND recovered_at_utc IS NOT NULL AND elapsed_ms IS NULL AND dispatch_count IS NULL AND forces_sent IS NULL AND captures IS NULL)))));
CREATE INDEX match_history ON match_records (profile_id, started_at_utc DESC, match_id DESC)
CREATE INDEX match_statistics ON match_records (profile_id, status, session_kind, difficulty, island_count)
CREATE INDEX match_execution ON match_records (profile_id, execution_id, status)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "xp_entries" ("entry_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles(profile_id), "match_id" TEXT, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('legacy_import', 'match_victory')), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0), "reward_version" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(reward_version)) > 0), "total_xp_before" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_xp_before >= 0), "total_xp_after" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (total_xp_after = total_xp_before + amount), "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(match_id, profile_id)REFERENCES match_records(match_id, profile_id), UNIQUE(match_id, reason), CHECK((reason = 'legacy_import' AND match_id IS NULL AND entry_id = 'legacy:' || profile_id)OR(reason = 'match_victory' AND match_id IS NOT NULL AND amount > 0)));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX legacy_import_once ON xp_entries (profile_id) WHERE reason = 'legacy_import'

CREATE TRIGGER victory_matches_receipt BEFORE INSERT ON xp_entries WHEN NEW.reason = 'match_victory' BEGIN SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM match_records WHERE match_id = NEW.match_id AND profile_id = NEW.profile_id AND status = 'completed' AND outcome = 'win' AND receipt_xp = NEW.amount AND receipt_before = NEW.total_xp_before AND receipt_after = NEW.total_xp_after AND receipt_reward_version = NEW.reward_version) THEN RAISE (ABORT, 'XP does not match victory receipt') END;END
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "storage_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "value" TEXT NOT NULL);
